primary_ratings: P is the MOS of HH participants; C=(P+S)/2; I is not a scoring target
talking_turns: Author-default thresholds and unweighted available-event macro
checkpoint: Single frozen-affect timing/silence checkpoint at step 4000

participant_roles.participant_order: Questionnaire response order; not speaker IDs or audio channels
participant_roles.natural: Both participants are uninstructed; uninstructed_participant_score is their mean
participant_roles.bilateral: Competitive Floor Conflict: both participants are instructed; instructed_participant_score is their mean; no uninstructed score. Excluded from uninstructed-participant MOS only (10 dev/20 test); retained in main results and discrimination
participant_roles.unresolved: Individual roles stay unresolved; equal scores determine both role scores without identifying the respondent
participant_roles.hai: Role columns are not applicable; existing dimension-specific HAI ratings are unchanged
participant_roles.uninstructed_combined: (uninstructed_participant_score + Supervisor)/2 on eligible H–H recordings only
participant_roles.privacy: No names, questionnaire respondent IDs or demographic fields are included
